_comment: EXTERNAL ground truth, hand-checked against the live game / published stats.
This file is the real accuracy gate: it is NOT generated from the game files,
so it independently pins the ingestion chain (milli-tile units, the shared
power ladder, the rarity offset, truncation, projectile damage lookup).
Add an entry only when you have actually confirmed the number. Never
regenerate this file from a build -- that would make the gate circular.
'display_level' is the rarity-independent level the game shows (11 = tournament standard).

Knight._source: confirmed: 1,766 HP, 202 damage per hit, 168 DPS, 1.2s hit speed, 3 elixir Common

Pekka._source: confirmed: 3,760 HP at level 11, 1.8s hit speed. NOTE: damage NOT anchored, see open_questions.

ArcherQueen._source: champion rarity offset check: base 391 at power index 0 x2.56 = 1000 at display 11

Rocket._source: well-established tournament-standard value; pins the spell projectile-damage path

Fireball._source: tournament-standard damage, 2.5-tile radius, reduced crown-tower damage

engine_constants._comment: Structural facts read out of the game files and cross-checked against live play.

open_questions.question: P.E.K.K.A damage at display level 11: extracted data gives 842 (base 329 x 2.56); some public stat sites report 510.
open_questions.why_it_matters: If 842 is wrong the whole damage-scaling path is wrong; but HP from the same multiplier verifies exactly on three cards, which argues the extracted value is right and the public tables are stale.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Open P.E.K.K.A's card page in-game at any level and read 'Damage'; compare against cr-sim's `validate` output for that same level.
